race.title: Total Event Rental 3-Y-O Hurdle
race.verdict: MOMENTUM OF LOVE arrives on the back of a hurdling success in France and is expected to maintain her unbeaten record now starting out for powerful connections. Danny Power has taken well to hurdling and is feared most, while newcomer Rio de La Pampa is also one to consider for a yard known for unearthing promising recruits. MOMENTUM OF LOVE (FR) DANNY POWER (IRE) RIO DE LA PAMPA (FR)
